checks.label: Minimum area of each inlet and outlet = 0.3 × N × I × S cm²: 24 cells at 20 A need 1440 cm² where people enter (S = 10) and 576 cm² in an enclosure (S = 4), and 12 cells need 720 cm²

Hydrogen ignites from 4 per cent, so a room people enter is held below 0.4 per cent (10% of 4) and an enclosure below 1 per cent (25% of 4): the gauge marks 0.4, 1 and 4, and lights the limit for the chosen room
An opening sized exactly by the rule holds the room at 4 ÷ S per cent: 24 cells at 20 A read 0.40 % through 1440 cm² and 1.00 % through 576 cm²
Halve the opening and the hydrogen doubles: at 10 A, 0.20 % through 1440 cm² becomes 0.40 % through 720 cm², and at 20 A, 720 cm² gives 0.80 %
Flow is area × speed: 1440 cm² is 0.144 m², which passes 14.4 L/s at 0.1 m/s; 1650 cm² passes 16.5 L/s; with the fan stopped, none
Sized from the 0.5 A float, 24 cells need only 36 cm², forty times less than the 1440 cm² a 20 A fault needs
55 cells at 10 A need 1650 cm² where people enter, 660 cm² in an enclosure, and 165 cm² with S left out
The gas grows in step with the current: no bubbles at 0 A, more as the current climbs, and the opening needed doubles when the current or the cells double
With the fan stopped the hydrogen keeps climbing: at 10 A through 720 cm² it rises from 0.40 % past 1 %, and during a 20 A equalise it climbs from 0.40 % towards 4 %
Valve-regulated cells: their bubbles fade and the hydrogen shows no number; the valve stays shut up to 10 A and lifts above it
After reaching the gassing voltage of 2.40 V a cell, a current limit of 2.5 to 5 A per 100 Ah is recommended: the screen on spare current says so
Each puzzle accepts only its right answer, and nothing in its picture gives the answer before Check
Fourteen screens: after the opening puzzle, demonstrations and puzzles take turns, three puzzles end it, and no demonstration says more than about 90 words
Both openings are drawn to one scale: each square's area follows its cm², so the outline for 720 cm² has half the area of the one for 1440 cm²
Every demonstration settles within 4.6 s and ends where its screen says, and every answer's motion settles within 2.5 s
